g.text: ACS712-05B nominal ±5A maps ~1.575-3.425V to ~0.90-1.96V through divider; verify exact module and pump startup current. ADC span is reduced.

g.desc: ACS712-05B nominal ±5A maps ~1.575-3.425V to ~0.90-1.96V through divider; verify exact module and pump startup current. ADC span is reduced.

g.text: Verify each module max output <=5V; J4 measures isolated low-voltage DC only, never mains. Relay logic compatibility and safe reset state are unresolved until exact module is identified.

g.desc: Verify each module max output <=5V; J4 measures isolated low-voltage DC only, never mains. Relay logic compatibility and safe reset state are unresolved until exact module is identified.

g.text: REFERENCE 30-pin map: J1 pins 7/8/5/6/3 = GPIO32 turbidity / GPIO33 ACS712 / GPIO34 voltage / GPIO35 soil / GPIO36 TDS; pins 10/11 = GPIO26 relay / GPIO27 flow.

g.desc: REFERENCE 30-pin map: J1 pins 7/8/5/6/3 = GPIO32 turbidity / GPIO33 ACS712 / GPIO34 voltage / GPIO35 soil / GPIO36 TDS; pins 10/11 = GPIO26 relay / GPIO27 flow.

g.text: R16/R17 are DNP relay-bias choices: populate exactly one only after verifying module active level and input circuit. Relay must not be operated until GPIO26 startup is safely biased.

g.desc: R16/R17 are DNP relay-bias choices: populate exactly one only after verifying module active level and input circuit. Relay must not be operated until GPIO26 startup is safely biased.

g.text: J2 pins 1/2/4/7/8/14 = VIN/GND/GPIO22/GPIO21/GND/GPIO4. Common reference only; verify clone pin order, row spacing, and orientation. J1/J2 footprints intentionally blank.

g.text: R1-R8: 15k/20k 1% dividers for confirmed <=5V outputs. R14/R15: soil 15k/75k divider from 3V3. R9: DS18B20 pull-up; flow conditioner is inverting.
